causal_hypothesis: At c32 decode, moving the per-row amax, E4M3 scale, and activation conversion into the first unchanged FP8 GEMM consumer or an equivalent consumer-coupled task removes a recurring launch and global quantized-activation write/read while preserving the stock per-token scale and GEMM output envelope.
stock_control: Pinned SGLang v0.5.13 dynamic per-token E4M3 activation producer followed by its unchanged fp8_scaled_mm consumer.
candidate_change: Implement one source-exact consumer-coupled dynamic-FP8 prologue or localized equivalent for the first production M=32,K=5376 QKV or gate/up projection family. Do not change model weights, quantization semantics, workload, downstream consumer result contract, or unrelated runtime paths.

immutable_scope.workload: exact campaign c32, 4214 prompt plus 358 completion tokens per request, dynamic chunking 2048, TP1, dynamic in-memory FP8 E4M3 linears, FP8 E5M2 KV

first_component_shape.N: derive and bind from the selected real QKV or gate/up weight before execution

required_before_claim: Inspect the selected opportunity, pinned fp8_utils.py producer and fp8_scaled_mm consumer, real projection weight geometry, and only the exact H200 trace/source needed for this boundary.
Implement one project-local mutable owner, worker, stock control, candidate path, high-precision or stock oracle, negative control, phase telemetry, and generation-fenced release path.
Compile or syntax-check every entrypoint and run lifecycle-pure CPU/source fixtures that can reject wrong row-scale indexing, saturation, zero/tiny-amax handling, layout, or stage bookkeeping.

Atomically publish FP8_PROLOGUE_H200_OWNER_READY.json with immutable hashes for the owner, worker, runner, selected source identities, exact M/K/N geometry, dtype/scale semantics, commands, output contract, and this binding.
owner_and_packet_contract.claim_rule: Only after FP8_PROLOGUE_H200_OWNER_READY.json is complete and all declared hashes verify, atomically claim the named available bench before claim_start_by_utc and record claimed_at, controller PID, start_ticks, state path, binding hash, and owner deadline in STATUS.json.active_session.
owner_and_packet_contract.durability: Use one detached mutable owner through the absolute deadline. It must heartbeat, preserve completed stage markers and resident inputs, accept hash-bound same-claim repairs for ordinary compile, API, path, permission, layout, telemetry, or container defects, and release generation-fenced after a decision-bearing terminal or the absolute deadline.
owner_and_packet_contract.replacement_permission: A process-local patch may replace the worker or container under the same claim after the patch is hash-bound and the scientific stage is proved unconsumed. Do not create a replacement provider bench or a second concurrent owner.

target_h200_sequence: Verify the registered instance, strict host fingerprint, H200 UUID, watchdog, claim generation, resident image, and selected real-weight identity once.

Run the smallest fresh-process H200 stock and candidate correctness calls through the actual fp8_scaled_mm consumer, synchronizing each first untimed arm independently and persisting arm completion markers.

Compare full consumed GEMM outputs against stock and a justified numerical envelope; report finiteness, maximum absolute error, relative L2, cosine similarity, saturation fraction, scale-indexing evidence, and any A/A variance. Structural divergence or nonfinite output stops timing.

If correctness passes, run profiler-off warm bracketed stock/candidate component repetitions on the exact production shape, with at least three independent candidate repetitions, raw samples, deterministic seed, full-output consumption, and compilation/autotuning excluded.

Record compiled registers, shared memory, spills, launch geometry, grid waves, and only the minimum counters needed to test whether launch/global activation traffic was removed without a resource regression.
Checkpoint every complete consumer family before starting another. Do not classify an incomplete family as interpretable.

Publish TASKGRAPH_FP8_PROLOGUE_H200_TERMINAL.json with immutable source/result hashes, candidate path proof, exact geometry and units, oracle results, timing distributions and paired interval, useful GPU seconds, provider exposure, whole-request bound, residual bottleneck, and typed promote, close, or blocked decision.

decision_rules.promote: The actual consumer is correct under the bound numerical contract, the complete producer-plus-consumer interval is reproducibly faster than stock, candidate-path proof is present, and the measured request-normalized bound justifies a scope-matched endpoint integration.
decision_rules.close: A correct source-exact implementation or localized H200 falsifier proves the scale barrier, resource cost, or complete interval removes the expected gain. Close only this dynamic-FP8 prologue mechanism.
decision_rules.blocked: Use only when the absolute deadline, unsafe state, exhausted cumulative authority, or an unrepairable exact-runtime incompatibility prevents a minimum interpretable stock/candidate result.
decision_rules.incomplete: A compile, API, permission, path, or pre-consumer failure is an invalid attempt and retains the claim for bounded same-project repair while time and authority remain.

prohibitions: Do not reopen or replay the QKV endpoint, fixed PQ, dual-RMSNorm, or decode-result host-wait arms.
Do not change per-token E4M3 scale semantics, weights, model revision, workload, runtime identity, or first selected projection after the first H200 scientific marker.
Do not infer whole-request gain from summed kernel or CUDA API duration.
Do not claim before the owner-ready record is hash-complete, after claim_start_by_utc, or on any bench other than the exact named H200.
Do not create, drain, delete, extend, or otherwise mutate provider lifecycle from the researcher.
